outcome.technical: R4: usage_ledger._scan_file now captures the main transcript's cost-state entries (never a subagent's) and scan_transcripts lifts the last one onto the session cursor as `cliCost`, so the meter records the CLI's per-session figure at meter time; a quiet later scan keeps it, a session with none has no key. New cost_state_of() is the one normaliser shared with read_cost_state; new recorded_cost_state(ledger_dir, sid) reads it back. audit-usage: new collect_cli_cost(sessions, ledger_dir, transcripts) prefers the cursor's figure (source=meter) and reads the transcript only for a session whose cursor holds none (source=transcript); cli_cost_lines names which in the CLI side's basis via _cli_basis(). LEFT OUT (sibling file set): the HTML report and the panel still have no cli_cost path, and audit-usage's --json payload does not carry cli_cost either. R5: read_cost_state docstring reworded to INFERRED, NOT MEASURED. The probe could not be made: this repo's project directory holds one session, fb1bddcc-aedf-4720-99d2-ec2a15fdf289, whose .jsonl carries no cost-state entry (a Python type Counter over it showed none; grep -l '"type":"cost-state"' found none); the docstring's cited session 0a7c2fcc... is not on disk (ls <outside-repo>*/0a7c2fcc* -> no matches). Running a probe on other projects' sessions that do carry one was refused by the host, verbatim: 'Permission for this action was denied by the Claude Code auto mode classifier. Reason: [PII Data Handling].' The compaction explanation is also marked a guess in read_cost_state and in session_start_check's docstring. R73: meter-usage._start_model reads the payload's `model` (cited to https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md, SessionStart input, optional field beside source) as the new session's model, keyed on that session; only when absent falls back to the previous session's last model, the line labelled as a fallback, keyed on the previous session. Dedupe lives in <ledgerDir>/.notices/<sid>.json (usage_ledger.start_notice_given / mark_start_notice), deliberately not in a cursor: rewriting another live session's cursor could write back a stale offset and double-count. Tests: test_usage_ledger cm1-cm4, test_audit_usage cc-cli6..cc-cli9, test_meter_usage c2, ss6-ss10; all new cases except cm3 (second-direction, passes on old code by construction) were seen FAIL before the fix: ledger 123/126, audit-usage 176/180, meter 56/62. After: 126/126, 180/180, 62/62. Full sweep `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py` in the tree exit 0, 335/335 files ok; a first sweep run failed gate-parity on a new module-level dict (_CLI_SOURCE_PHRASE read as an unclassified reason table) - replaced by a function - and test__proc_group with a PermissionError under the sweep (not my file; passes alone 24/24, and on the re-run). ruff check plugins/audit tools exit 0; vermin -t=3.8- exit 0.
outcome.descriptive: The CLI's per-session cost is recorded when metered and read back by /audit:usage, the SessionStart unpriced-model notice reads the new session's model once per session and model, and the cost-state subagent claim is now marked inferred.
